metadata.description: The root monitoring.config.json as normalized by `npm run deploy`, which also supplies reportingGroups.
Reporting groups from `npm run deploy`: [{ id, displayName, scopes: [{ tenant, service, journeys }] }].
Created only when OTEL exports to Azure Monitor.

variables.$fxv#1:
// Failed live steps with the impacted group and user, the error and the target, newest first.
AppTraces
| where Message == 'synthetic-step' and tostring(Properties['probe.mode']) == 'live'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.step_status']) == 'failed'
| project TimeGenerated,
    Group = coalesce(tostring(Properties['monitoring.group_name']), '(no group)'),
    User = coalesce(tostring(Properties['monitoring.user']), '(n/a)'),
    Peer = tostring(Properties['monitoring.peer']),
    Service = tostring(Properties['probe.service']),
    Journey = tostring(Properties['probe.journey']),
    Step = tostring(Properties['probe.step']),
    Error = tostring(Properties['probe.diagnostic_category']),
    Detail = tostring(Properties['probe.detail']),
    Target = tostring(Properties['probe.id']),
    CorrelationId = tostring(Properties['probe.correlation_id'])
| order by TimeGenerated desc
variables.$fxv#2:
// Users with failed live steps per group, most affected first.
AppTraces
| where Message == 'synthetic-step' and tostring(Properties['probe.mode']) == 'live'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.step_status']) == 'failed'
| summarize Failures = count(),
    Journeys = make_set(tostring(Properties['probe.journey'])),
    Errors = make_set(tostring(Properties['probe.diagnostic_category'])),
    FirstFailure = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastFailure = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Group = coalesce(tostring(Properties['monitoring.group_name']), '(no group)'),
    GroupId = tostring(Properties['monitoring.group']),
    User = coalesce(tostring(Properties['monitoring.user']), '(n/a)')
| order by Group asc, GroupId asc, Failures desc
variables.$fxv#3:
// Success rate of live attempts per group, service and journey, weakest first.
AppTraces
| where Message == 'synthetic-result' and tostring(Properties['probe.mode']) == 'live'
| extend Success = tobool(Properties['probe.success'])
| where isnotnull(Success)
| summarize Attempts = count(), Succeeded = countif(Success)
    by Group = coalesce(tostring(Properties['monitoring.group_name']), '(no group)'),
    GroupId = tostring(Properties['monitoring.group']),
    Service = tostring(Properties['probe.service']),
    Journey = tostring(Properties['probe.journey'])
| project Group, GroupId, Service, Journey, Attempts, Failures = Attempts - Succeeded,
    SuccessPercent = round(100.0 * Succeeded / Attempts, 1)
| order by Group asc, GroupId asc, SuccessPercent asc

variables.telemetryQuery:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where _ResourceId =~ '__APPLICATION_INSIGHTS_RESOURCE_ID__'
| where Message == '__MESSAGE__'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.schema_version']) == '2.0'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.mode']) == 'live'
| where tostring(Properties['monitoring.group_duplicate']) != 'true'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.service']) == '__SERVICE__'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.journey']) == '__JOURNEY__'
| where '__STEP__' == '' or tostring(Properties['probe.step']) == '__STEP__'
| where Message != 'synthetic-step' or tostring(Properties['probe.step_status']) in ('succeeded', 'failed')
| where Message == 'synthetic-step' or isnotnull(tobool(Properties['probe.success']))
| extend ObservedAt = todatetime(Properties['probe.observed_at'])
| where ObservedAt > ago(15m) and ObservedAt <= now()
| extend Success = iff(Message == 'synthetic-step',
    iff(tostring(Properties['probe.step_status']) == 'succeeded', 1.0, 0.0),
    iff(tobool(Properties['probe.success']), 1.0, 0.0)),
    Duration = todouble(Properties['probe.duration_ms'])
| where isnotnull(Duration) and Duration >= 0
| summarize Value = __AGGREGATION__
| where isnotnull(Value)
